integrity_notes: Two algorithmically different exhaustive enumerations independently compute all permutation neighborhoods and agree entry by entry. Full size-five and size-six tables, programs, and exact counts are provided. Bibliographic novelty has not undergone independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Complete finite computation and bijective verification only for k=2,3,4,5,6; primary new extremal counts are for k=5,6. No assertion is made for k>=7 or for other word classes.
title: First non-cyclic maximizers in permutation-neighborhoods of double-occurrence shuffle words
